datasets.name: Himachal Pradesh Public Procurement & Health Tenders (OCDS)
datasets.source: State Public Procurement Portal (hptenders.gov.in / GePNIC) & CivicDataLab OCDS Repository
datasets.publisher: Government of Himachal Pradesh & CivicDataLab / Open Contracting Partnership

datasets.description: Authentic public procurement tenders, contracts, and supplier award records from the Government of Himachal Pradesh (FY 2017-18 to FY 2020-21) standardized into the Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS). Covers medical equipment, hospital civil works, healthcare infrastructure, and district procurement.
